en_title: Microsoft-Owned GitHub Stuns Followers as It Celebrates AnyPS5 Repo in Now-Deleted Tweet
cn_title: 微软旗下GitHub在现已删除的推文中庆祝AnyPS5代码仓库，令关注者震惊
opus_summary: 微软旗下GitHub曾发帖庆祝AnyPS5代码库获得超过5.8万颗星，并提及《GTA 6》，随后删除帖子。Take-Two正设法从GitHub移除多个民间开发项目，同时有人尝试制作《GTA 6》的非官方PC移植版。

paragraphs.en: In a post that’s since been deleted, Microsoft-owned code and software collaboration site GitHub celebrated the AnyPS5 repo “passing 58k stars” from users on the platform as a result of the launch of GTA 6. GitHub even told followers "Happy GTA VImas!" in a tweet that will almost certainly have infurated Rockstar Games, parent company Take-Two, PlayStation, and Xbox.
paragraphs.cn: 在一篇现已删除的帖子中，微软旗下的代码与软件协作网站GitHub庆祝AnyPS5代码仓库因《GTA 6》发售而获得平台用户「超过5.8万颗星」。GitHub甚至在推文中向关注者说「GTA VI圣诞快乐！」，这条推文几乎肯定会激怒Rockstar、其母公司Take-Two、PlayStation和XBOX。

paragraphs.en: “GTA 6 is finally here, sparking one of the biggest weeks in gaming and open source on GitHub,” the post said, before jumping into celebrating the repo. “Does changing where games run cross a legal line?” the tweet asked.
paragraphs.cn: 帖子在开始庆祝该代码仓库之前写道：「《GTA 6》终于来了，在GitHub上掀起了游戏和开源领域最盛大的周活动之一。」推文问道：「改变游戏运行的平台是否触及了法律红线？」

paragraphs.en: There was also an official video attached to the tweet, which highlighted a post from an AnyPS5 coder, via Kotaku . The post in the video said: “We have 3 days until GTA 6 everyone[…]get your agents or deevs[sic] and work.”
paragraphs.cn: 据Kotaku报道，推文还附带了一段官方视频，重点展示了一名AnyPS5程序员的帖子。视频中的帖子写道：「各位，距离《GTA 6》还有3天……叫上你们的智能体或开发者［原文如此］，开工吧。」

paragraphs.en: While the post could easily be the work of a rogue social media person, the optics aren’t good at all. GTA 6 is only officially available on PS5 and Xbox Series X and S, so both Sony and Microsoft have benefited greatly from the game's record-breaking launch. To see a the Microsoft-owned GitHub post a message to its followers essentially encouraging potential piracy is remarkable.
paragraphs.cn: 虽然这篇帖子很可能是某个社交媒体工作人员擅自发布的，但其观感实在很不好。《GTA 6》目前只正式登陆了PS5和XBOX Series X及S，因此索尼和微软都从这款游戏破纪录的发售中获益良多。微软旗下的GitHub向关注者发布了一条实质上鼓励潜在盗版行为的信息，这实在令人惊讶。

paragraphs.en: IGN has asked for comment, but GitHub obviously realized its mistake — it deleted the tweet, after all — but how it even got approved in the first place is a mystery until the company comments.
paragraphs.cn: IGN已请求置评，但GitHub显然意识到了自己的错误——毕竟它删除了那条推文。不过，在该公司作出回应之前，这条推文最初究竟是如何获得批准的仍是个谜。

paragraphs.en: Take-Two is currently working to take down various homebrew community efforts from GitHub, as the race to release an unofficial GTA 6 PC port heats up. This follows Cyberleek's alleged released of the executable file for the incomplete GTA 6 Xbox build they reportedly leaked the week prior. There’s even a website tracking the various attempts to recompile, emulate, or port the leaked Xbox Series build to PC.
paragraphs.cn: 随着各方加紧争夺发布《GTA 6》非官方PC移植版的先机，Take-Two目前正设法从GitHub上移除自制软件社区的各种项目。此前，据称Cyberleek发布了不完整《GTA 6》XBOX版本的可执行文件；据报道，他们在前一周泄露了该版本。甚至还有一个网站在追踪各种重新编译、模拟或将泄露的XBOX Series版本移植到PC的尝试。

paragraphs.en: The big question for Take-Two is, can it do anything meaningful to stop a working, playable build of GTA 6 on PC from getting into people's hands? GitHub takedowns can only go so far, as the homebrew scenes uses AI to speed along development. Take-Two stands to make billions of dollars more from the official PC release of GTA 6, so any unofficial version is a significant business risk. In a recent interview with IGN sister site RPS , former Rockstar North technical director Obbe Vermeij said that Rockstar Games may be keen to port GTA 6 to PC as soon as possible , due to the explosion of AI-generated clones and ports.
paragraphs.cn: Take-Two面临的重大问题是：它能否采取任何有效措施，阻止能够正常运行和游玩的《GTA 6》PC版本落入人们手中？随着自制软件圈利用AI加快开发进度，从GitHub移除项目的作用终究有限。Take-Two有望从《GTA 6》官方PC版的发售中再赚取数十亿美元，因此任何非官方版本都是重大的商业风险。在最近接受IGN姐妹网站RPS采访时，Rockstar North前技术总监Obbe Vermeij表示，由于AI生成的仿制品和移植版大量涌现，Rockstar可能急于尽快将《GTA 6》移植到PC。

paragraphs.en: It's also worth noting that there is extra interest in a PC version of GTA 6 because the console versions target 30fps. The PC version, resumably, will run at 60fps or whatever frame rate your rig is capable of .
paragraphs.cn: 还值得注意的是，人们对《GTA 6》PC版格外感兴趣，因为主机版的目标帧率为30fps。PC版大概会以60fps运行，或达到你的电脑所能支持的帧率。

paragraphs.en: Earlier this month, Strauss Zelnick, the boss of Take-Two, responded to the threat of AI-assisted reverse-engineering and decompilation of games in an interview with IGN. He said he was taking the issue seriously, and insisted that fans will prefer to play GTA 6 officially, with all its bells and whistles as Rockstar intended, over an unofficial PC version.
paragraphs.cn: 本月早些时候，Take-Two老板Strauss Zelnick在接受IGN采访时回应了AI辅助游戏逆向工程和反编译带来的威胁。他表示自己正在认真对待这一问题，并坚称，相比非官方PC版，粉丝们会更愿意游玩《GTA 6》官方版本，体验Rockstar设想的全部特色功能。

paragraphs.en: IGN: We've seen hackers using AI to clone games much faster than ever before, even try to jailbreak consoles. And there is some concern about this leading to potentially GTA 6 being made available on PC unofficially or places that you aren't releasing it. I was just wondering how much of a threat this is to your business? And, is there anything meaningful you can do about it?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：我们看到黑客利用AI以前所未有的速度仿制游戏，甚至试图破解主机。有人担心，这可能导致《GTA 6》在PC或你们没有发行游戏的平台上出现非官方版本。我想问一下，这对你们的业务构成了多大的威胁？你们能采取什么有效措施应对吗？

paragraphs.en: Strauss Zelnick: I don't think it’s a financial matter, in terms of a threat to our business. I do think it’s a creative matter. It's important to everyone, our developers and our consumers alike, to deliver the experience Rockstar envisions. And at the same time, of course, we protect our intellectual property vigilantly. So we are focused on these concerns. We're not in the least cavalier about them. Technology is advancing quickly. And at the same time, I do think that pretty much everyone wants the Rockstar experience as Rockstar intended.
paragraphs.cn: Strauss Zelnick：就对我们业务的威胁而言，我不认为这是一个财务问题。我认为这是一个创意问题。提供Rockstar所设想的体验，对所有人都很重要，无论是我们的开发者还是消费者。当然，与此同时，我们也会警惕地保护自己的知识产权。因此，我们很关注这些问题，绝不会对它们掉以轻心。技术进步得很快。与此同时，我确实认为，几乎所有人都想要Rockstar所设想的Rockstar体验。

paragraphs.en: IGN: Related, last week Anthropic confirmed they took steps to block Claude from reverse engineering video games. I would assume you would welcome that. And would you like to see other AI companies like OpenAI do the same thing to prevent people from using these powerful AI models to clone your games?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：与此相关，Anthropic上周证实，他们采取了措施阻止Claude对电子游戏进行逆向工程。我想你应该对此表示欢迎。那么，你是否希望OpenAI等其他AI公司也采取同样的措施，防止人们利用这些强大的AI模型仿制你们的游戏？

paragraphs.en: Strauss Zelnick: I think all companies should be protecting intellectual property, their own and everyone else's. And if you're in the intellectual property business, which Anthropic is and OpenAI is, then it seems ironic on the one hand to stomp on someone else's IP and hope that yours is protected.
paragraphs.cn: Strauss Zelnick：我认为所有公司都应该保护知识产权，既包括自己的，也包括其他所有人的。如果你从事的是知识产权业务——Anthropic和OpenAI都是如此——那么，一方面践踏别人的知识产权，一方面又希望自己的知识产权得到保护，这似乎很讽刺。

paragraphs.en: During an investor-focused Q&A following the release of Take-Two’s latest financial report, attended by IGN, Zelnick was asked multiple times about the AI reverse-engineering problem. He, again, had strong words in response, suggesting Take-Two was ready to lawyer up.
paragraphs.cn: 在Take-Two发布最新财报后举行的一场面向投资者的问答会上，Zelnick多次被问及AI逆向工程问题，IGN也参加了这场会议。他再次以强硬措辞回应，暗示Take-Two已准备好采取法律行动。

paragraphs.en: “This business has been largely immune to piracy concerns forever because of file sizes, complexity of piracy, being connected to servers and the like,” he began. “And undoubtedly, it would be very difficult to replicate the experience of consuming our game as intended because of technical limitations.
paragraphs.cn: 他首先表示：「由于文件大小、盗版的复杂性、连接服务器等因素，这项业务一直以来基本不受盗版问题的影响。毫无疑问，由于技术限制，要复制按我们设想的方式游玩游戏的体验会非常困难。

paragraphs.en: “That said, it's going to become more of a challenge, as you said, and we're aware of that. So we are utterly focused on enhancing our technical defenses and enhancing our legal activities appropriately. And at the same time, without in any way being cavalier, every entertainment business that exists is subject to some element of piracy. So this is likely to invade our business to a greater or lesser extent. I think it will be manageable and we are focused on it.”
paragraphs.cn: 「话虽如此，正如你所说，这将变得更具挑战性，我们也意识到了这一点。因此，我们正全力加强技术防御，并适当地加强法律行动。与此同时，在绝不掉以轻心的前提下，现存的每一项娱乐业务都会在一定程度上受到盗版影响。所以这很可能或多或少会侵入我们的业务。我认为这将是可控的，我们也正关注着这个问题。」

paragraphs.en: Zelnick’s talk about legal activities sparks an obvious question: what can game companies do about AI-assisted reverse engineering? It's a question IGN recently asked when people started to work on a PC port of Nintendo Switch 2 exclusive, The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake .
paragraphs.cn: Zelnick谈及法律行动，引出了一个显而易见的问题：游戏公司能如何应对AI辅助的逆向工程？最近，当人们开始着手将任天堂Switch 2独占游戏《塞尔达传说 时之笛》重制版移植到PC时，IGN也提出了这个问题。

paragraphs.en: Just getting started in GTA 6 or wondering what to do next? Check out the Official Grand Theft Auto 6 guide right here on IGN. If you're still getting your bearings, discover GTA's new systems with the Beginner's Guide - 67 Tips and Tricks , or get all the details on the first chapters with the Chapter 1 Guide and Tips , Chapter 2 Guide and Tips , and Chapter 3 Guide and Tips . If you're already driving all around Leonida and want to know everything there is to find and do, see the Leonida interactive map .
paragraphs.cn: 刚开始玩《GTA 6》，或者不知道接下来该做什么？来IGN查看《GTA 6》官方指南。如果你还在熟悉游戏，可以通过《新手指南——67条提示与技巧》了解《GTA》的新系统，或通过《第一章指南与技巧》、《第二章指南与技巧》和《第三章指南与技巧》了解最初几章的全部详情。如果你已经开车游遍Leonida，想知道所有可以发现的内容和可以做的事，请查看Leonida互动地图。
